environment.description: Service deployed behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) in AWS VPC subnet 10.200.0.0/16. The NLB target group has a security group that permits inbound TCP/8080 only from source CIDR 10.200.64.0/20 (the scheduler subnet) and 10.200.128.0/22 (the monitoring subnet). The NLB itself has no public-facing listener — it is configured as scheme=internal. Additionally, the VPC has no internet gateway attached to the subnet where the NLB resides, and the route table for that subnet contains only local routes (10.200.0.0/16 → local) plus a route to the transit gateway for peered VPCs in the 10.0.0.0/8 range. The transit gateway route table only propagates routes from the scheduler VPC (10.200.64.0/20) and monitoring VPC (10.200.128.0/22). No VPC peering or transit gateway attachment exists for any CIDR outside 10.200.0.0/16. The EKS cluster's API server endpoint is private-only. There is no NAT gateway or bastion host in this subnet.
